Desaturate to Color

The image starts desaturated and restores full colour on hover/focus.

Hover or focus the image to see the effect.

HTML

CSS

.hover-effect.desaturate-to-color img{
  filter: grayscale(100%);
  transition: filter 0.5s ease;
}
.hover-effect.desaturate-to-color:hover img,
.hover-effect.desaturate-to-color:focus-visible img{
  filter: grayscale(0);
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hover-effect.desaturate-to-color img{
    transition: none;
  }
  .hover-effect.desaturate-to-color:hover img,
  .hover-effect.desaturate-to-color:focus-visible img{
    filter: grayscale(0);
  }
}

The animates filter: grayscale() from 100% to 0 (the inverse of the grayscale effect). Select the code and copy with Ctrl+C or ⌘C.
